name: ui_top_panel
description: FULL-SCREEN HUD ROOT as a REAL canvas+widget tree (WEAPON-BAR-FOLD 2026-10-20): the root carries a screen-mode `canvas` (1280x720) + the ui_top_panel_bind script, and EVERY element — HUD values/statuses AND the bottom weapon bar + FULL ARMORY overlay — is a CHILD WIDGET ENTITY. Groups: hud_group (anchored top — the classic HUD rows), weapon_group (anchored bottom — the folded-in weapon bar: 9 interactive quick-pick slot panels, prev/next page arrows, page indicator, +N armory affordance, [STORE] button, status line), armory_group (anchored center — the full-armory overlay: 33 interactive row panels; open/close = the bind script writing render.visible on the REAL panels). Every button carries its behavior as a VISIBLE script: the generic ui_weapon_action with its action/slot/row as declared params (WAVE-3 widget interaction seam; clicks dispatch onPointerClick through window.__se.weaponActions, which main.js wires). NO hidden data carriers: the ONLY authored render.visible is the armory_group backdrop itself - a REAL panel subtree whose closed state is its resting state (a closed dialog), opened/closed by the bind script from the feed. The bind script writes LIVE values (aim row, statuses, wind, paged weapon slots, overlay rows) into the widgets each step; labels/colors/layout live ONLY on the entities.
